title: dryopteris macrochlamys
intro: Dryopteris macrochlamys, commonly known as the Himalayan shield fern, is a species of fern native to the Himalayan region. It is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris macrochlamys include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These constituents have been shown to exhibit potential therapeutic effects, including the inhibition of pro-inflammatory enzymes and the scavenging of free radicals.
